explain_task.question: Using the revised model and its LP-relaxation diagnostics, explain why the objective increased from 1005.0 to 1025.0 even though `overtime_penalty=120` in `general_parameters.csv`. Your answer must trace the exact code additions `z[m]` and `lpSum(x[(m, p)] for p in parts) <= ot_threshold + len(parts) * z[m]` back to the business rule in `docs/business_requirement.md`, name the CSV parameter columns and values (`overtime_threshold=4`, `overtime_penalty=120`, `max_parts_on_C=3`), and identify which machine is effectively at the overtime boundary in the revised optimal solution using the specific assignment variables `x_A_1`, `x_B_6`, `x_B_7`, `x_C_10`, etc. Then, interpreting the LP-relaxation state, discuss which revised constraints are binding versus slack, what the shadow price/business marginal meaning would be for the machine-load/overtime threshold if it were read from the relaxation, and why that marginal interpretation cannot be linearly extrapolated to claim that changing the threshold by 1 type would simply change the MIP objective by the same amount.
